title: feat(wordcount): support aggregated statistics for multi-cursor multiple selections
body:
## Feature Overview
Enhance the built-in wordcount plugin to calculate total selected text when using multiple cursors.

### Problem
Original logic only reads the primary selection via `editor.getSelection()`. When users select several discontinuous text blocks with multi-cursor, the "Selected" count on the status bar only counts the first range, causing inaccurate statistics and misleading operation feedback.

### Implementation
1. Replace single `getSelection()` with `getSelections()` to obtain all cursor ranges
2. Filter empty cursor positions without actual selection
3. Deduplicate overlapping selected ranges to avoid repeated accumulation
4. Reuse existing internal `countMarkdown` method to sum characters / words / lines
5. Fully backward compatible: single cursor mode remains completely unchanged, no breaking changes

### Quality & Compatibility
- Added regression unit test for multi-cursor multi-selection scenario
- Local full test passed: single selection, multi non-overlap selection, overlap selection, empty cursor all work correctly
- ESLint lint rules and all existing test cases passed locally

### Self-test Result
1. Single cursor single selection → consistent with original statistics
2. Multi-cursor non-overlapping text → sum all selected content normally
3. Overlapping selected area → deduplicate counting
4. Blank cursor without selection → Selected shows 0
